title: Rock! Croak!
summary:
Rock! Croak!



● 3 New Leaderboards arrived
● New Chess Piece: Largo ($2/Naga/Monk), Ability<Frogstomp>
● Brewmaster: Downgraded from $2 to $1
● Pandaren - Hospitality
● Minotaur Horn: Upgraded from T3 to T4.
● Mango Tree: Reworked. A Golden Mango will be dropped only when the mango tree is still alive at Relic expiration.(opposite to the previous condition). Mango tree’s health increased from 7 to 8.
● Magic Box: Stacks decreased from 15 to 12.
● Talent2B - Ascendency: Chances for +1 level recruitment decreased from 75% to 60%
● Fix bugs

Click the title link to check the full update details!
